0.content: Kongamato is a huge Yumkasaur who lived through the cataclysm. Burkina's companion, he took severe Abyssal infection while fighting at his side and, in rage, killed him. Ashamed, he has asked since to be put down. The Scions of the Canopy hold regular Turnfire rituals to drain some of his energy; in the Last Turnfire Night quest he fought the Traveler, then Kinich shielded him with his Ancient Name, and Kongamato chose to live with his shame and train future heroes.

1.content: The Fruitful Hook is a claymore-class hooked sword that Burkina made with Tenoch's help to harvest Flamegranates from the mother tree on a peak above the clouds. Burkina trained with the winged Saurians, the mountain people and the Night-Wind priests, then climbed. A gust nearly threw him, until Kongamato rescued him with its tongue; Burkina shared the fruit, and the best Flamegranates are named "Mountain Kings" in the Yumkasaur's honour.
